description: This file defines an AuthProvider class in Flutter that manages authentication state, including login and logout functionalities. It interacts with an AuthRepository for remote operations and uses environment configuration to determine operation mode.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A minimal authentication provider managing login state, capable of handling local and remote login/logout processes.

methods.name: setLoggedIn
methods.description: Sets the internal login state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Attempts to log in using provided credentials; performs local or remote login based on environment setting.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, clearing authentication state, and calling remote logout if configured.
